not_found.what_was_tried: NDA 2026-07-28 transcript (only 智算 share >80% and 140万PFLOPS connected to the platform), NDRC 2026-08-31 (245万PFLOPS national; >85% for 8 hubs + 3 zones), 数字中国发展报告（2025年）(1129 monitored facilities, 102万PFLOPS monitored). No rack aggregate after the June-2024 195万架.

unit_notes: FP32 vs FP16: 算力总规模 (140→180→230→280 EFLOPS, 2021–2024) is explicitly FP32 in 数字中国发展报告（2024年）; 智能算力 (788 mid-2025, 1,590 end-2025, 1,882 Mar-2026, 2,185 Jun-2026 EFLOPS) is FP16. Never divide the FP16 智算 figure by the FP32 total to get a share.
PFLOPS→EFLOPS: 159万PFLOPS = 1,590 EFLOPS; 102万PFLOPS = 1,020 EFLOPS; 240万PFLOPS = 2,400 EFLOPS; 17.6万PFLOPS = 176 EFLOPS; 33.8万P = 338 EFLOPS (1 EFLOPS = 1,000 PFLOPS).

Racks: all national figures are '标准机架' (2.5 kW equivalent); 万架 converted to thousands (1373万 → 13,730). Series label drift: 数据中心机架 (≤2023) → 算力中心机架 (2024–mid-2025) → 算力设施机架 (end-2025). The 通信业统计公报 93.8万 figure covers only the three basic telecom operators.

PUE definition change: 2024 report = average of all 算力中心 (1.46); 2025 report = 超大型算力设施 only (1.34). The 十五五 plan's 1.25 (2025) is the 运行PUE of 新建大型超大型算力设施 (new builds). The NEA 1.3左右 is the average of all facilities in the 8 hub clusters.
Utilization scopes: 55% (2021) and 71.4% (Jun-2026) are national; 62.72% (Mar-2024) covers the 10 clusters; 63% (Jun-2024) covers the 8 hub nodes.

Hub share: edwc23_new_compute_share is a flow (share of NEW capacity each year: 60%以上 2024, 80%以上 2025); the NDA July-2026 '超80%' is a STOCK share of 智算 only; ndc3_hub_share (stock share of all compute) has never been published.

Storage: 存力总规模 (capacity: 800 EB 2021, >1000 EB 2022, ~1.2 ZB 2023, >1680 EB mid-2025) differs from 数据存储量/数据存储总量 (data stored: 724.5 EB 2022, 1.73 ZB 2023, 2.53 ZB 2025). 先进存力 540 EB (2025) is the only official advanced-storage figure.
5G 普及率 (per 100 population; 85.7% end-2025, 75.9% Mar-2025) ≠ 5G share of mobile users (65.9% end-2025). 千兆用户 2.38亿户 (公报) = 23,839万户 (NBS) ≈ 2.4亿 (plan table rounding).
ICT revenue: 信息通信行业收入 3.8万亿 (2025; basic telecom + above-scale internet firms) vs 电信业务收入 1.75万亿 (2025; telecom only).

Cluster figures: 张家口 81万架 is city-wide and '投运' (in service); 芜湖 12万架 is '建成' (built); 韶关 Tier C figures are '承载能力' (built capacity) not in-use; 贵阳贵安 174 EFLOPS is city+new-area scope, 智算 >98%, so effectively FP16.
Floors: many official figures are '超过/以上' floors (140, 180, 900万, 1373万, 1590, 60%, 80%, 1680 EB) and are recorded at the floor value.
